# SENZ Strategic Communications and Digital Solutions

FMB&CO → SENZ Strategic Communications & Digital Solutions → SENZ products and services.
Public website: https://www.senzpr.com/

SENZ sells and explains. SENZ App delivers authorized tools. Legit Official Site acquires and routes demand.
Public inquiries and quotations do not activate a product. No automatic checkout or payment processing is offered.
The application is not production verified. Current offers require feasibility and commercial review.

- SENZ Workspace: Draft, summarize, rewrite, and structure real work with saved, versioned outputs. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. Uses only what you provide. It does not browse the web, send, or publish anything, and every draft needs human review. https://www.senzpr.com/products/ai-workspace.html
- SENZ Communications Intelligence: Message briefs, stakeholder plans, clarity reviews, and issue preparation with human approval. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It does not publish or send messages, and it does not replace legal advice or a crisis team. https://www.senzpr.com/products/communications-intelligence.html
- SENZ Digital Assistant: An assistant that answers only from your approved knowledge and hands off to a person. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It replies only from your approved knowledge: an answer must cite it, and every number, date, price, or contact detail must appear in what it cites, or the question goes to your team. It does not take payments or make bookings. https://www.senzpr.com/products/digital-assistant.html
- SENZ Client Portal: Contracted project workspace for milestones, deliverables, revisions, and approvals. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. Set up by SENZ for each contract. It is not a general CRM, form builder, or public file-sharing service. https://www.senzpr.com/products/client-portal.html
- SENZ Event Systems: Event publishing, capacity-safe RSVP, waitlists, check-in, and attendee export. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It does not sell tickets or run voting or tabulation. https://www.senzpr.com/products/event-systems.html
- SENZ Digital Representative: Consent-based, disclosed text representative for a brand or person, with human approval. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. Text only. It has no voice or video likeness and is never presented as the real person. https://www.senzpr.com/products/digital-representative.html
- SENZ QR Menu: A public menu with a QR code, sections, prices, dietary tags, and sold-out items. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. Dietary information is entered by the business and is not checked by SENZ. It does not take orders or payments; guests show their list to staff. https://www.senzpr.com/products/qr-menu.html
- SENZ Booking: Online appointment requests that you confirm, with no double-booking. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It does not take payments or deposits and sends no messages or reminders; you contact customers yourself. https://www.senzpr.com/products/booking.html
- SENZ Digital Catalog: A shareable product catalog with search and inquiry lists. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It does not take orders or payments or track stock; you reply to each inquiry yourself. https://www.senzpr.com/products/digital-catalog.html
- Legit Official Site: A managed one-page website for your identity, work or organization, with photos and an inquiry inbox. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. The current renderer uses a path on the configured SENZ App host. Automatic subdomains, custom domains, multi-page editing, blogs, arbitrary plugins and online payments are not implemented. Published edits appear immediately; unpublish for private revisions. https://www.senzpr.com/legit-official-site/
- SENZ CRM: Contacts, stages, follow-ups, and notes for a small team. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It does not send emails or messages and does not import contacts from other systems. https://www.senzpr.com/products/crm.html
- SENZ POS and Inventory: Counter sales, stock counts, and daily totals. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It records sales and stock only. It is not a BIR-registered POS, does not issue official receipts or invoices, and does not process card or e-wallet payments. https://www.senzpr.com/products/pos.html
- SENZ Loyalty: A digital stamp card tied to your counter sales. Request a Quote. Technical state: development. It sends no messages and has no public member page; members ask your staff for their card. A voided POS sale takes back its stamp. https://www.senzpr.com/products/loyalty.html
